rationale: H7 (reviews/hcl/master-review.md). Two forms, both pinned here: the explicit `iterator = r`, and — the one the first fix still missed, caught by this fixture — the DEFAULT, where Terraform names the local after the block's OWN LABEL, so `dynamic "egress"` binds `egress`. Corpus measurement: `dynamic` occurs 360 times.
